{{Quote|Captain, uh, my scopes just picked up a ghost image in our sensor wake.''"<br />"''Probably another glitch like that false biosignature we saw in the cargo hold earlier.|The co-pilot and captain of ''1729'' are duped by Jango Fett|<ref name="SWBHvg" />}}
'''''1729''''' was a [[Supply ship/Legends|supply craft]] for the [[Desolation Alley]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility on the [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] both made use of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to infiltrate Desolation Alley. Wesell stowed away in ''1729''{{'s}} cargo hold while Fett concealed [[Jaster's Legacy|his ship]] in the supply ship's [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] wake on approach to Oovo IV. ''1729''{{'s}} sensors reported both events, but the crew of the ship dismissed both as sensor glitches, and the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters were able to infiltrate the prison facility.

==Description==
A [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]],<ref name="SWBHvg" /> ''1729'' was larger than an [[Amphibious Interstellar Assault Transport/infantry|AIAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]]<ref name="size">Although no dimensions are given for ''1729'', ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' depicts an [[Amphibious Interstellar Assault Transport/infantry|AIAT/i]] immediately behind the supply ship, and ''1729'' can easily be seen to be larger.</ref>&mdash;which had a wingspan of thirty-one [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>&mdash;and was crewed by at least two people. The hull was flat on the underside of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and painted a shade of [[Color/Legends|yellow]]. The [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] was located high on the bow of the ship and offset to the left to accommodate a [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] to the right; the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array being augmented by a [[Rectenna/Legends|rectenna]] atop the vessel. ''1729'' was propelled by three [[Sublight engine/Legends|thrusters]] on the aft of the ship; one larger located centrally, and a smaller thruster on either side. The supply ship was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], as well as a [[Life-form scanner/Legends|lifeform scanner]] in the cargo hold.<ref name="SWBHvg" />

==History==
[[File:ThatsNoGhostImageItsAJango-SWBH.jpg|thumb|left|270px|''Jaster{{'s}} Legacy'' hides behind ''1729''.]]
''1729'' was used for delivering supplies to [[Desolation Alley]], a [[Republic Correctional Authority/Legends|Republic Correctional Authority]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. On one particular supply run in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the supply craft's sensors reported a biosignature in the cargo hold. The crew dismissed the anomaly as a glitch, not knowing that it was caused by the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], who had stowed aboard. The supply ship exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] at Oovo IV for a standard approach, the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] around the prison being lowered for ''1729'' to pass though.<ref name="SWBHvg" />

The [[1729's co-pilot|co-pilot]] noticed a ghost image in their sensor wake, which, unbeknownst to the crew, was caused by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], another bounty hunter.<ref name="SWBHvg" /> Fett used [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to keep his ship, ''[[Jaster's Legacy]]'', directly behind ''1729''<ref name="SWBH-Prima">[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> so that he could infiltrate Desolation Alley. Assuming the ghost image to be related to the biosignature reported earlier, the [[Unidentified captain (1729)|captain]] told their co-pilot to check again. However, Fett had already split off from ''1729''{{'s}} trajectory, and the anomaly was dismissed as another glitch, allowing Fett to land undetected. The supply ship landed at Desolation Alley's [[Spaceport/Legends|supply port]] and unloaded its cargo before taking off sometime later.<ref name="SWBHvg" />

==Commanders and crew==
At the helm of ''1729'' was the captain and their co-pilot. On approach to Desolation Alley, the captain communicated with the prison [[Desolation Alley landing controller|landing controller]] while the co-pilot checked the ship's sensors.<ref name="SWBHvg" />

==Behind the scenes==
''1729'' first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', during an in-game cutscene providing an introduction to the "Asteroid Prison" chapter of the game.<ref name="SWBHvg" />
